title: Opera introduces a new web standard to let users deploy AI locally in their browser
script:
Opera just introduced a new web standard called WebAI.
It lets you deploy AI models directly inside your browser.
The standard is specifically designed to work with a wide variety of different models.
Instead of relying on remote cloud servers, processing happens locally on your own device.
This shift gives you complete control over your data without sending queries externally.
Would you run local AI models in your browser?
